name: Oya Browser
description: Real Chrome for AI agents, with the person's own logins. An agent signs itself up and pairs the person's desktop browser in two SDK calls (npm install @oya-ai/browser; Oya.signup({ email }); new Oya().desktop.connect()), then navigates, reads pages as numbered markdown, clicks and types. Also runs on Oya Cloud, Browserbase, Steel, Anchor or Browser Use. Start at https://oyabrowser.com/llms.txt.

skills.name: Self-setup with the SDK
skills.description: Get an API key with no person or dashboard (Oya.signup), and pair the person's Oya desktop app with their Chrome logins imported (oya.desktop.connect). See 'Agent quickstart' in /llms.txt.
examples: Set up Oya Browser for me and use my logged-in browser

skills.name: Browser Automation
skills.description: Navigate to URLs, analyze page content, click elements, type text, take screenshots, scroll, and manage tabs in a real Chrome browser.
examples: Navigate to https://example.com and analyze the page
Click the login button and fill in the form
Take a screenshot of the current page

skills.name: Browser Pool
skills.description: Dispatch commands across multiple browsers with round-robin load balancing and shared cookie synchronization.
examples: Run the same search across 5 browsers in parallel
Check pool status and connected browsers
